Content: Daeun are 10-year periods that step forward or back from your month pillar. Each decade is read as a different 'climate' for your chart.

Content: Readers ask whether a decade brings the element your chart needs for balance or one it already has too much of. Hard decades are read as times to move carefully, not as fixed bad luck.
